body: Nasdaq-100 futures were about 1.2% lower in Reuters reporting, with long Treasury yields near multi-year highs, Brent around $91, the VIX at a two-week high and broad technology/chip weakness. Strait of Hormuz disruption adds a discontinuity risk. Independent bar-level retracement evidence remains incomplete, limiting Tail escalation.
